Subject: Project Submission and Performance Review

Hi [Name],

I noticed that the deadline for the recent project submission was missed. This is the second time this has happened, and it is becoming a pattern that we need to address.

It is important that we meet our basic expectations and deadlines to ensure the team can move forward effectively. I would like to schedule a meeting with you to discuss this matter in more detail and talk about how we can improve your workflow and reliability moving forward.

Please let me know your availability for a brief chat later this week.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
